summary: Ontario fire tower at Waboose, known from a December 1963 newspaper item about its woman ranger; no source found describes the site today.

events.note: The item says a woman had been the ranger at the tower for the previous five years; Mrs. Theresa Linard of Nipigon was then the ranger, recently transferred and promoted.

evidence.supports: Item is a Winnipeg Free Press report, as quoted on the page
Tower at Waboose, 190 miles northeast of Port Arthur
evidence.quote: the forest ranger operating the fire tower at Waboose, 190 miles northeast of Port Arthur, Ont., has been a woman

evidence.supports: Ranger had been a woman for the previous five years
evidence.quote: For the last five years, the forest ranger operating the fire tower at Waboose

evidence.supports: Ranger was Mrs. Theresa Linard of Nipigon, recently transferred and promoted

evidence.supports: Most Ontario towers erected between the 1920s and the 1950s
evidence.quote: Most of the towers were erected between the 1920's and the 1950's when forest fire protection was in it's heyday.

evidence.supports: Towers came under the Department of Lands and Forests, which became the Ministry of Natural Resources in 1972
evidence.quote: They came under the jurisdiction of Ontario's former Department of Lands and Forests which became the Ministry of Natural Resources in 1972.

corrections.why: The 1963 item calls Waboose a fire tower, so the kind can be set from the source rather than left unknown.

sources.title: Ontario's Fire Tower Lookouts: Preserving Their History

notes_for_editor: Only one primary item (a 1963 Winnipeg Free Press report, quoted on the Canada Lookouts page) describes Waboose. No source found gives a build date, design, agency, current status or access today; the ontario_lio and firelookout_ca caches and two searches turned up nothing more. The record's coordinates (50.7075, -88.0142) are about 273 km (170 miles) at roughly 18 degrees from Port Arthur, while the 1963 item says 190 miles northeast; the location is from the same Canada Lookouts site, so it may be a map point rather than a surveyed one. The record's kind was unknown and is proposed as tower. Staffing as_of 1963 reflects the item's date only.
